entry.title: Único Serie Papas Fritas — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola or dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Compact dark Liga session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Cocoa, espresso, leather, earth, cedar and black pepper give the original Papas Fritas the dark, smoke-heavy character expected from Liga Privada. Premium Liga tobacco trimmings are used in a compact mixed/short-filler format beneath Connecticut Broadleaf and Brazilian Mata Fina, making this one of the cheapest ways to access the darker Único/Liga flavour family. At A$30.70 for a substantial 4½″ × 44 single, it is a particularly strong projected value candidate. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the exact Australian Único Serie Papas Fritas single at A$30.70 and 4½″ × 44, with the single variant available. The local SKU dimensions are used here. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
